name: Search Converts pricing
model: Every engagement is quoted to the business after one conversation (a free strategy session). There is no contract until the client is ready to sign one.

ranges.service: Managed campaigns (conversion optimization, paid media, email, AI marketing)
ranges.note: Most campaigns run $500 to $3,000 a month; scope and spend decide the fee.
The 12-point self-check and the strategy session are free; a paid deep audit is quoted per site.

ranges.service: Landing page, conversion copy, website and app builds
ranges.note: Quoted per project after the brief. Web-designer pages (Shopify, WordPress, Webflow, Wix, Squarespace) are quoted per site.
Quoted per engagement; one-on-one coaching and team programs priced on headcount and duration.

guarantees: No ranking, traffic or revenue guarantees. The client owns every account and asset.
